nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) were used for normative modeling of between-network resting-state functional connectivity. The mgcv package v1.8-42 in R was used. A smoothing function was applied to age (predictor) to model possible non-linear trajectories, where the effective degrees of freedom (edf) statistic reflects the degree of non-linearity. Mean relative motion was included as a covariate.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: For each between-network rsFC ( FCi ), normative trajectories were modeled with Generalized Additive Models (GAMs) for the training dataset using the mgcv package v1.8 -42 (Wood, 2011). To model possible non-linear trajectories, a smoothing function was applied to age (predictor), where the effective degrees of freedom (edf) statistic reflects the degree of non-linearity of a curve.

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Between-network resting-state functional connectivity (rsFC) was the response variable. Seven large-scale cortical resting-state networks from Yeo et al. (2011) were used as ROIs: Visual Network (VN), Somatomotor Network (SMN), Dorsal Attention Network (DAN), Ventral Attention Network/Salience Network (VAN), Limbic Network (LN), Frontoparietal Network (FPN), and Default Mode Network (DMN). This resulted in 21 unique between-network rsFCs. Functional connectivity matrices were computed by measuring bivariate correlation coefficients of BOLD time series between seed and target ROIs through a hemodynamic response factor (hrf)-weighted general linear model.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Regions of interest (ROIs) were seven large scale cortical restingstate networks [ Visual Network (VN), Somatomotor Network (SMN), Dorsal Attention Network (DAN), Ventral Attention Network/Salience Network (VAN), Limbic Network (LN), Frontoparietal Network (FPN) and Default Mode Network (DMN )], identified by Yeo et al. (2011). For each scan, functional connectivity matrices were computed by measuring the bivariate correlation coefficients of the BOLD time series between each seed and target ROIs through a hemodynamic response factor (hrf)-weighted general linear model. ... With seven functional networks as ROIs, we have a total of 21 unique between-network rsFCs.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age was the primary predictor in the GAM normative model with a smoothing function applied to model non-linear trajectories. Mean relative motion (fMRI motion parameter) was included as a covariate of no interest. Site effects were handled separately via ComBat harmonization prior to normative modeling, not as a covariate in the model itself.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: To model possible non-linear trajectories, a smoothing function was applied to age (predictor), where the effective degrees of freedom (edf) statistic reflects the degree of non-linearity of a curve. Mean relative motion was included as a co-variate of no interest.
